title: PEAD Revival with ML and Historical Earnings Sequences (12-Quarter Features)
source: ScienceDirect 2025 — 'Beyond the last surprise: Reviving PEAD with machine learning and historical earnings'
rationale: Research published 2025 (ScienceDirect, Journal of Financial Economics or similar) shows that ML models using 12 quarters of historical earnings data nearly double the Sharpe ratio of simple 1-quarter EPS surprise models. The key insight: PEAD decays rapidly when trained only on the most recent surprise, but remains strong when the model learns the full time-series of earnings revisions, surprises, and analyst forecast patterns. This is a direct upgrade path for our H174 production PEAD model (currently using 1-quarter EPS surprise + FinBERT score). Adding 12-quarter earnings history as features to a gradient boost model could substantially improve the signal without requiring additional API subscriptions (yfinance provides quarterly EPS history).

design.signal: LightGBM model with 12-quarter features: EPS surprise history, analyst revision patterns, beat/miss streaks, seasonality
design.universe: S&P 500 companies with >= 12 quarters of EPS history (via yfinance quarterly earnings)
design.baseline: H174 current: FinBERT score >= 0.18 + EPS surprise >= 2% (OOS WR=81.8%)
design.target: Augment H174 entry decision with ML probability score using 12-quarter feature vector
design.ml_model: LightGBM binary classifier (pip install lightgbm — likely already available)

confirm_gates.oos_win_rate: > 65% (vs H174 baseline 81.8% — must not regress while expanding universe)
confirm_gates.vs_h174: Must improve either win rate by 5pp OR expand qualifying event count by 50% without losing win rate

hypothesis_log_entry.note: PEAD upgrade: add 12-quarter EPS history features via yfinance to LightGBM model. 2025 research shows 12q window nearly doubles Sharpe vs 1q surprise. Builds on H174 CONFIRMED baseline (FinBERT + surprise gate). Implementation risk: yfinance quarterly history completeness — may drop to 500 events with partial data. Test coverage before committing.
hypothesis_log_entry.paper: ScienceDirect 2025 — 'Beyond the last surprise: Reviving PEAD with machine learning and historical earnings'
